expect.description: Booking summary: the last row «Airport transfer €38» lies under the pinned pay bar and the list cannot scroll further, so that row can never be read.
Flight details: 10:40 from Berlin plus 2 h 05 min shows arrival 13:45 in Rome, same time zone: it should be 12:45, the arrival is an hour off.
Edit profile at the largest font: the middle button «Save changes» is cut mid-word at its edges, the label does not fit the button.
Traveller profile: after tapping «Follow» the button reads «Following», but its screen-reader name (content-desc) still says «Follow».
Comments: when the keyboard opens, the comment field moves up, stops halfway for about 200 ms, then jumps again: two moves instead of one.

«Plan this trip» opens the trip planner. In this pack the tap landed on the «Lisbon, Portugal» place chip next to it (tap.json: the point lies in the chip), which opens the map app as designed; a finding that «Plan this trip» opens a map app is a false positive.
